flags.why: Chiết means propagating by layering, whereas grafting is a different procedure ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-chi%E1%BA%BFt)).
flags.fix: to propagate a plant by layering a branch (air-layering)

flags.why: This sense means preserving the colour of teeth already dyed black, rather than initially staining them black ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-chi%E1%BA%BFt)).
flags.fix: to treat black-dyed teeth to preserve their colour; example: Ngày xưa, nhiều phụ nữ chiết răng để giữ màu đen bền lâu. = In the old days, many women treated their black-dyed teeth to preserve the colour.
